summary: A complete first abstract architecture for The Wandering Islands, built directly from the Story Vision; no accepted Identity exists, so everything here is a noncanonical agent proposal. Governing promise: earned hope in a world worth inhabiting, which the author states in their own words. Causal organization (agent proposal; engine_hierarchy, complexity and causal_distribution are UNKNOWN): a primary engine with subordinate layers. The primary engine is the moving geography itself. Islands genuinely move and nobody can predict where, so distance, contact and knowledge are always provisional. One inhabited island failing to return breaks the only reliability the communities had, which turns the background condition into a series-scale mystery problem. Four subordinate engines draw pressure from that rupture: bonds sustained across distance (warmth and belonging under strain), competing interpretations of the absence (mystery and conflict), opportunity and consequence (who gains or loses from the disruption, which drives complicated choices), and generosity as heroism (courage expressed as giving and reaching out across the sea). A sixth mechanism, revisable understanding, turns accumulated clues into revelations that reshape how the world is understood and push the scale outward. Genres (provisional): fantasy governs (author-named), mystery supports (author-named), exploration adventure supports (implied by 'exploration'), and communal slice-of-life is a tertiary agent proposal carrying warm everyday life. The abstract series movement runs from a living world and its rupture, through search, competing readings, widening consequence and a reframing of the world, to a convergence in earned hope. Phase order is not Book numbering, and durations are unknown. The twelve-Book target is honored through nested setups and payoffs: each Book closes a local question and advances the series question. Load-bearing inventions (whether the migrations have a discoverable cause, what 'not currently predictable' implies, and the possible fate of the absent island's people) are recorded as interpretations rather than facts.

nodes.title: Earned hope in a world worth inhabiting
nodes.summary: Governing emotional promise, stated by the author. The reader should come to love a beautiful, inhabited world and then feel hope that has been paid for by choices, losses and generosity, never handed over as a predetermined victory.

nodes.title: Wonder and beauty
nodes.summary: Author-declared. Wonder at a world where whole inhabited islands move, and at the beauty of a life built around that motion. Wonder renews as understanding of the world changes, instead of fading once the premise is familiar.

nodes.title: Warm everyday life and belonging
nodes.summary: Author-declared. Belonging that does not depend on fixed places: friendships, markets, celebrations and shared craft that keep people connected across changing seas. This is the emotional ground the rupture threatens.

nodes.title: Consequential choices and generous heroism
nodes.summary: Author-declared. Choices whose consequences matter, and heroism that is generous and courageous rather than conquering. The reader should feel the weight of what each choice costs others.

nodes.title: Growing scale, intimate stakes
nodes.summary: Author-declared. The world and its stakes widen over the series, but every expansion is felt through specific relationships and households rather than through abstract strategy.

nodes.title: Luminous inhabited texture
nodes.summary: Agent proposal. Sensory specificity of everyday practice: craft, food, festival, trade and hospitality rendered so the world feels worth inhabiting. Beauty is shown through what people make and share, not only through landscape.

nodes.title: The provisional horizon
nodes.summary: Agent proposal. A recurring aesthetic of instability: maps, routes and expected neighbors are always provisional. It makes the familiar feel precious and the unknown feel open, sustaining both warmth and wonder.

nodes.title: Fantasy (governing)
nodes.summary: Author-named. Supplies the secondary-world premise of genuinely migrating islands, a sense of wonder, and the long-horizon series form. Governs because the world rule is the source of every other pressure.

nodes.title: Mystery (supporting)
nodes.summary: Author-named. The island that did not return is the central mystery problem. Clues, false explanations and revelations organize the investigation and reshape understanding of the world over many Books.

nodes.title: Exploration adventure (supporting)
nodes.summary: Agent proposal grounded in the author's 'exploration'. Voyages into changing or uncharted waters deliver wonder, physical risk and discovery, and are the main vehicle for the series' growing scale.

nodes.title: Communal slice-of-life (tertiary)
nodes.summary: Agent proposal. Carries warm everyday life: the practices that sustain relationships across migration. A tertiary register, it restores belonging between pressures and supplies the stakes the larger plot threatens.

nodes.title: Primary engine: the moving geography
nodes.summary: Agent proposal for the primary engine. Unpredictable migration of inhabited islands continually reconfigures distance, contact, access and knowledge. It is renewable because each migration can open or close relationships, routes and opportunities, and it is author-fixed as genuine and currently unpredictable.

nodes.title: The broken cycle
nodes.summary: The author-fixed rupture: every known inhabited island has reappeared, until one does not. It converts the background engine into a mystery problem with human stakes and starts every subordinate engine. Ownership: the world rule; pressure: uncertainty about the absent island's fate.

nodes.title: Bonds sustained across distance
nodes.summary: Subordinate engine. Relationships survive migration only through deliberate practice. Each new displacement tests whether a bond is maintained, which produces warmth when it holds and grief or estrangement when it fails.

nodes.title: Competing interpretations
nodes.summary: Subordinate engine. Communities read the absence differently: as loss, omen, opportunity, accident or concealment. Each reading licenses different actions, so disagreement becomes conflict without needing a villain. It is renewed whenever new evidence makes an existing reading stronger or weaker.

nodes.title: Opportunity and consequence
nodes.summary: Subordinate engine. Disruption creates advantages: vacated routes, shifted trade, leverage over the displaced. Actors who pursue them create consequences for others, and that drives the complicated choices the author asked for.

nodes.title: Generosity as heroism
nodes.summary: Subordinate engine. Heroic action is defined as costly reaching-out: searching, sheltering, sharing scarce knowledge or resources, and keeping faith with the absent. Its payoff mechanic is that generosity creates the bonds and knowledge later hope depends on.

nodes.title: Revisable understanding
nodes.summary: Cross-cutting engine. Clues from search and voyage accumulate into revelations that change what the communities believe about migration. Each revision widens scale and reopens questions instead of closing them all. This is the long-horizon mystery engine.

nodes.title: The vanished home
nodes.summary: Function: an absent place whose fate is uncertain, generating both grief and a quest. It must stay humanly specific (people, ties, obligations) rather than becoming an abstract puzzle box.

nodes.title: The wandering gathering
nodes.summary: Function: the traveling market or celebration as a network node where bonds are renewed, news and rumors circulate, and interpretations collide. Author-supplied practice, abstracted as a recurring structural space.

nodes.title: The voyage into changed waters
nodes.summary: Function: a crossing in which geography itself may have moved, delivering wonder, risk and clues. It is the main device for expanding scale.

nodes.title: Friendship kept across distance
nodes.summary: Function: a bond that persists through separation via ritual, message and gift; its holding or breaking is a barometer of the world's strain.

nodes.title: The comforting false explanation
nodes.summary: Function: red herring at community scale. An interpretation that is attractive because it is reassuring or profitable, later revealed as incomplete or wrong, which reframes earlier choices.

nodes.title: The costly gift
nodes.summary: Function: generosity whose cost is visible, making heroism consequential and creating later obligations and payoffs.

nodes.title: Belonging without fixed place
nodes.summary: Home and community are sustained by practice and care, not by fixed geography. The rupture tests whether this belief survives when one place does not come back.

nodes.title: Understanding as revisable
nodes.summary: Knowledge of the world is provisional; wisdom is responding well to what cannot yet be predicted. It contrasts certainty-driven actions with adaptive, generous ones.

nodes.title: Generosity versus advantage
nodes.summary: Disruption tempts people to take advantage; the series weighs the costs and long-term consequences of giving against those of taking.

nodes.title: Series thread: the search for the absent island
nodes.summary: The long-horizon question of where the island is and what happened to it, and later what its absence reveals about migration itself. Carried across Books through nested sub-questions.

nodes.title: Series thread: practices under strain
nodes.summary: Long-horizon thread tracking how the community practices that sustain relationships adapt, fracture or renew as uncertainty grows.

nodes.title: Twelve-Book nested spine
nodes.summary: Author-fixed twelve-Book target. Agent proposal: a nested setup and payoff spine in which the series question (the broken cycle) frames Book-scale questions. Each Book closes a local question while advancing or reframing the series question.

nodes.title: Book-scale closure unit
nodes.summary: Agent proposal. Each Book delivers a local resolution (a bond restored or lost, a choice paid off, a piece of the world understood) and leaves a widened question, so individual Books satisfy while the series accumulates.

nodes.title: Scale ladder
nodes.summary: Agent proposal. Stakes and geography widen in steps (household, community, archipelago, the nature of the world), with each step anchored to an intimate relationship so scale never abandons human concerns.

nodes.title: Shifts of narrative emphasis
nodes.summary: The author requires capacity for meaningful changes in emphasis, relationships, conflicts and scope. Agent proposal: genre dominance rotates across phases (community, mystery, exploration, consequence) under the governing fantasy promise, without abandoning it.

open_questions: Should the series be told through a single central perspective, a small ensemble, or a rotating cast across Books?
How dark may the losses become (for example permanent loss of the absent island's people) while still keeping the governing optimistic promise?
Should the migrations ever become predictable or controllable by the end, or should the series affirm living well with unpredictability?
Who is the intended readership (age range and tonal register), which affects how violence and moral compromise are treated?

opportunities.title: The absence as an unrecognized gift or warning
opportunities.why_it_matters: If the non-return turns out to protect, warn, or reconnect rather than simply wound, the mystery could deepen the generosity theme at world scale.
opportunities.artistic_potential: Lets the world itself echo the theme of costly giving, and could make the central revelation emotionally rich instead of purely informational.
opportunities.intention_fidelity: Compatible with earned hope and wonder; risks sentimentality if the hope is not paid for by real loss.

interpretations.interpretation: Working reading: the migrations have an underlying order that can be partly discovered over the series. 'Not currently predictable' means not yet understood, not unknowable.
interpretations.consequences: Lets mystery and revelation drive long-horizon scale growth and supports changing understandings of the world.
interpretations.alternative: The migrations stay fundamentally unpredictable; the series is about adaptive living rather than discovery, and revelations concern people and history rather than mechanism.

interpretations.interpretation: The architecture keeps the fate of the absent island and its people deliberately unknown. It assumes only that the absence has human stakes and that its resolution honors loss.
interpretations.consequences: Preserves many realizations, ranging from survival elsewhere to permanent loss, without committing to one.

interpretations.interpretation: Conflict comes mainly from competing interpretations and opportunity-seeking under uncertainty rather than from one antagonist who caused the absence.
interpretations.consequences: Keeps heroism generous and choices complicated; antagonism stays human and contextual.
interpretations.alternative: A deliberate concealing force exists behind the absence, giving mystery a culprit structure.

emotion_targets.intended_effect: Delight in a beautiful world that feels worth inhabiting.
emotion_targets.eliciting_condition: Encounters with migrating islands, crafted beauty and newly discovered parts of the world.
emotion_targets.aesthetic_strategy: Sensory specificity of everyday craft and landscape; a provisional horizon that keeps renewing the unknown.

emotion_targets.intended_effect: Warmth of friendship and belonging across distance.
emotion_targets.eliciting_condition: Bonds that hold through migration via gatherings, gifts and ritual.
emotion_targets.aesthetic_strategy: Intimate rendering of shared practice and hospitality.

emotion_targets.intended_effect: Hope that feels earned, not predetermined.
emotion_targets.eliciting_condition: Generous choices and maintained bonds paying off after real costs.
emotion_targets.aesthetic_strategy: Payoffs explicitly built on earlier setups; losses acknowledged in the moment of hope.

emotion_targets.eliciting_condition: Clues, voyages and revelations that overturn assumptions.
emotion_targets.aesthetic_strategy: Fair accumulation of clues; red herrings that reframe rather than cheat.

emotion_targets.intended_effect: Tension at what courageous, generous action risks.
emotion_targets.eliciting_condition: Characters choose to give or reach out at real personal cost.
emotion_targets.aesthetic_strategy: Make the cost visible before the choice; keep heroism personal and generous.

emotion_targets.intended_effect: Grief for the absent and for strained bonds.
emotion_targets.eliciting_condition: The non-return and the fracturing of relationships it causes.
emotion_targets.aesthetic_strategy: Small, concrete traces of absent people and places within everyday life.

emotion_targets.intended_effect: Moral indignation at people exploiting disruption.
emotion_targets.eliciting_condition: People seizing advantage from others' loss or uncertainty.
emotion_targets.aesthetic_strategy: Show consequences landing on specific people; avoid cartoonish villainy.

emotion_targets.intended_effect: Unease that the world's one reliability has failed.
emotion_targets.eliciting_condition: The first non-return and its unknown implications.
emotion_targets.aesthetic_strategy: The familiar rendered slightly wrong; silences where expected contact should be.
